overview.description: Proposed multimodal prediction and policy separation.

fusion-families.description: Four architecture families to compare under the same contract.

architecture.description: Proposed joint transformer and independent semantic candidate scoring.

candidate-equivariance.description: Softmax values of fixed illustrative logits; not model predictions.

attention-scaling.description: Pair counts: 6*N^2 versus N*32+6*32^2+8*32. Not a hardware benchmark.

proper-scoring.description: True q=.7; log/Brier regret is minimized at p=q; sampled correctness reward is maximized at p=1.

counterfactuals.description: Hand-built task illustrations with deterministic scene-oracle labels.

research-loop.description: Proposed evidence-driven population search; no loop has executed.

evaluation-firewall.description: Four distinct split roles with a one-way model-selection flow.

two-level-research.description: Proposed separation of model optimization and later research-policy optimization.

eval-suites.description: Planned real-data capability suites; no measured evaluation results.

audio-screen-architecture.description: Proposed native speech/audio and screenshot fusion, distinct from the synthetic control.

implemented-joint.description: Implemented native candidate scorer. Architecture diagram, not a performance claim.

developer-api.description: Multimodal input validation, cached neural scorer, and typed deterministic output views.

shape-color-prior.description: Renderer-specific fixed dark-ink map and learned shape/color branches; no performance claim.
